nodes.title: Round 8: she knows the child first by choosing among verified things, not by generating during the lesson. Four layers: (1) selection by code from the learner model (topic, opener, compressed units, first card, remediation, hook, joints), checked by predicates; (2) dress: an example's nouns and labels from authored closed sets per interest, same numbers and key, validator proves every line and board true for every dress; (3) library: mix-up-aimed visuals generated offline, judged by Claude in batches, approved into the ready-made library; (4) live generation only for template families where predicates at three screen sizes are enough. Why: earlier display failures all came from ungated live generation; a model never grades; judges are Claude in-session and builds are Azure-only, so judged generation must happen ahead of the lesson; layers 1 and 2 cost nothing per lesson. Reverse if: a child sees a repeated example or visual within five lessons on a topic (widen layer 4 for that family); layer 4 shows 0 display faults over a judged batch of 100 across three sizes (it becomes the default for that family); dress costs Learning more than half a day per topic (generate dress offline and judge it).

Round 8: one pure module (server/director/knows.js, planFor) turns learner state into a scripted lesson's choices (opener, hook slot, compressed skills, first card, remediation per card, ladder order) and returns a because record {choice, fact, source} for each; state.js keeps one call site per choice; a predicate throws in tests when the walk departs from script order with no because; the parent's lesson page shows the because lines. Choices K1-K8: compress a learned skill with a passed delayed check (a miss returns to the full unit), success first, remediation by the child's real mix-up, prerequisite check, no new skill before a test or in week one, hook and joints by interest through the registry, opener after a gap, prefer a scripted topic among equals. The brief is cut at lesson start from learner state whether or not a day plan exists. Why: the learner audit found seven plan decisions computed then dropped at seven seams (LEARN-20); the walk reads no learner state today (state.js walks every beat in kit order). Reverse if: a choice needs mid-turn state planFor cannot see without running every turn (then a per-turn reader, still one module). Done when: two simulated children with different histories get lessons differing in four named ways with no model call (evals/knows-her), and a judged run scores 'taught this child' at 3.5+ with the existing gate passing.

Code trace on int/r6 (integration 24 tree), read-only, by a Sonnet agent for main, n = one pass over server/routes/lesson.js, server/director/state.js, script.js, items.js, server/content/next-topic.js, server/learner/**, server/play/**, server/stagecraft/**, server/forge3/**: the script walk reads no learner state (walks every beat of every scripted skill in kit order, state.js:1282-1290); per-child variation in a scripted lesson is the hook's interest slot (exact label match; 4 onboarding tiles have no slot, 2 slots name tiles that do not exist), the language, and a friend name picked from a fixed list; the lesson brief passes only wrapAt and hardStopAt and is usually null (TAXILA_CONDUCTOR_PLAN off); script cards and game levels do write kt_evidence (script:<skill>:..., play:<levelId>) and the ledger folds them; no generated visual can be shown (nothing sets a verdict; judgeArtifact has no caller); 4 scripts are live and 30 staged. Not verified by the trace: whether 'simpler used' counts as assisted, whether a script give-up weighs as a kit leave, the writer's params_version default (kt-r2) against the ledger's kt-r3, live legal modes.

md.decisions:
## `dc-r8-selection-before-generation` (2026-11-10)

Round 8: she knows the child first by choosing among verified things, not by generating during the lesson.

| Layer | What changes per child | Checked by |
|---|---|---|
| 1. Selection | topic, opener, compressed units, first card, remediation, hook, joints | predicates; no model |
| 2. Dress | an example's nouns and labels, same numbers and key | validator, for every dress |
| 3. Library | mix-up-aimed visuals built ahead of the lesson | Claude judges in batches |
| 4. Live | a visual built in the lesson | predicates at three sizes, for template families where that is enough |

**Why:** earlier display failures all came from ungated live generation; a model never grades; judges are Claude in-session and builds are Azure-only, so judged generation happens ahead of the lesson; layers 1 and 2 cost nothing per lesson.

**Reverse if:**
- a child sees a repeated example or visual within five lessons on a topic: widen layer 4 for that family;
- layer 4 shows 0 display faults over a judged batch of 100 across three sizes: it becomes the default for that family;
- dress costs Learning more than half a day per topic: generate dress offline and judge it.

Plan: docs/design/round8/PLAN.md.

## `dc-r8-one-reader-with-because` (2026-11-10)

One pure module, `server/director/knows.js` (`planFor`), turns learner state into a scripted lesson's choices and returns a `because` record for each. `state.js` keeps one call site per choice. A predicate throws in tests when the walk departs from script order with no `because`. The parent's lesson page shows the `because` lines.

**Choices:** K1 compress a learned skill (a miss returns to the full unit); K2 success first; K3 remediation by her real mix-up; K4 prerequisite check; K5 no new skill before a test or in week one; K6 hook and joints by interest through the registry; K7 opener after a gap; K8 prefer a scripted topic among equals.

**Why:** the learner audit found seven plan decisions computed and then dropped at seven seams (LEARN-20), and the walk reads no learner state today.

**Reverse if:** a choice needs mid-turn state `planFor` cannot see without running every turn (then a per-turn reader, still one module).

**Done when:** two simulated children with different histories get lessons differing in four named ways with no model call (`evals/knows-her`), and a judged run scores "taught this child" at 3.5 or above with the existing gate passing.
md.measurements:
## `ms-r8-walk-reads-no-learner-state-2026-11-10` (2026-11-10)

A read-only code trace of the integration 24 tree (one pass, by a Sonnet agent for main; no tests run).

- The script walk reads no learner state: it walks every beat of every scripted skill in kit order (`server/director/state.js:1282-1290`).
- Per-child variation in a scripted lesson: the hook's interest slot (exact label match; 4 onboarding tiles have no slot, 2 slots name tiles that do not exist), the language, and a friend name from a fixed list.
- The lesson brief passes only `wrapAt` and `hardStopAt`, and is usually null (`TAXILA_CONDUCTOR_PLAN` is off).
- Script cards and game levels do write `kt_evidence`, and the ledger folds them.
- No generated visual can be shown: nothing sets a verdict, and `judgeArtifact` has no caller.
- 4 scripts are live, 30 staged.

**Not verified by the trace:** whether "simpler used" counts as assisted; whether a script give-up weighs as a kit leave; the writer's `params_version` default (kt-r2) against the ledger's kt-r3; live legal modes. These are with the learner session.
